name: Corporate Identity, Inc. West Virginia
old_description: Looking for a specific item or just browsing for ideas? Your veteran owned business, Corporate Identity, Inc., is your one-stop shop for promotional products and business gifts. Our extensive range of promo products will ensure you find something to suit your requirements.
about:
Corporate Identity, Inc. operates from St. Albans, West Virginia, as a veteran-owned distributor of promotional products and branded merchandise. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders publicly.

The company sources and supplies a wide range of promotional items—including apparel (T-shirts, hoodies, jackets, caps), tote bags, drinkware, writing instruments, and accessories—and provides decoration services such as screen printing, embroidery, and dye sublimation tailored to garment type and order quantity. Its online catalog lists thousands of SKUs across categories like everyday use, back-to-school, and awards & recognition.

Corporate Identity serves businesses and organizations seeking branded merchandise for marketing, employee recognition, and events. Its product showcases highlight automotive, military, and western-themed promotional lines, indicating demand from automotive dealers, veterans' groups, and agricultural or rodeo-affiliated clients.

The company emphasizes fast turnaround, budget-friendly pricing, and personalized product recommendations as its differentiators, positioning itself as a one-stop shop that handles product selection and decoration under one roof.
